audit_results.name: Feature Ordering & Protocol Mask
audit_results.code_evidence: Order matches canonical list 0-20. Protocol mask 7:11 (proto_tcp, proto_udp, proto_icmp, proto_other)
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper Section III-A lists features in 4 metric groups.

audit_results.name: Flow Timeout Parameters
audit_results.code_evidence: inactivity_timeout=15.0s, max_flow_duration=120s in iot_ids/config.py and flow_builder.py
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper describes 21 flow metrics but omits explicit 15s/120s timeout values in text.
audit_results.details: Recommendation: Add explicit 15s inactivity and 120s max duration mention in Section III-A of paper.

audit_results.name: Chronological 60/20/20 Split
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper line 115 explicitly states 'standardized 60/20/20 chronological train/validation/test splits'.

audit_results.name: Dataset Sample Counts
audit_results.code_evidence: 7,000 flows total (4,200 train / 1,400 val / 1,400 test) per dataset
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper Section IV-A lists 4,200 train / 1,400 validation / 1,400 test for each dataset.

audit_results.name: State Reset at Split Boundaries
audit_results.code_evidence: Flow generator resets state between train, val, and test splits
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper line 115 explicitly states 'with detector state reset at split boundaries to prevent data leakage'.

audit_results.name: Train-Only Scaler Fitting
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper line 70 states 'clamped using robust scaler parameters fitted on benign training distributions'.

audit_results.name: Random Forest Hyperparameters
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper line 75 states 'ensemble of 100 decision trees'. (Paper omits max_depth=15).
audit_results.details: Recommendation: Paper can optionally specify max_depth=15 in Section III-B.

audit_results.name: Standard MLP Architecture
audit_results.code_evidence: 21->128->64->32->1, BatchNorm, ReLU, Dropout(0.2), Adam lr=0.001, epochs=15, batch_size=256
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper line 76 states '21 -> 128 -> 64 -> 32 -> 1 with Batch Normalization, ReLU activations, and Dropout (p=0.2)'.

audit_results.name: Robust MLP & PGD-7 Training
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper line 82-86 details PGD-7 training with epsilon=0.1, alpha=0.025, k=7.

audit_results.name: Option C Probability Fusion
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper Equation (1): P_Option C = 0.7 * P_RF + 0.3 * P_MLP.

audit_results.name: Differential Privacy Bounds & Scope
audit_results.code_evidence: Neural stream only, C=1.0, sigma=1.0, batch_size=64, delta=1e-5, Opacus PRV accountant, eps=2.37
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper Section III-C states (eps=2.37, delta=10^-5)-DP under Opacus PRV accountant, neural stream exclusively.

audit_results.name: XAI Weighted Component Attribution
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper line 98-101 defines Weighted Component Attribution Aggregation with 0.7 RF + 0.3 MLP normalized weights.

audit_results.name: PGD-10 Adversarial Evaluation
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper Section IV-B and Section V-B state PGD-10 attack at epsilon=0.1, alpha=0.025, 10 iterations.

audit_results.name: Adversarial Evaluation Scope Clarification
audit_results.code_evidence: Gradients computed on neural stream, perturbed samples evaluated on RF and Option C
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper line 177-178 explicitly states PGD-10 perturbations were generated using neural stream gradients and evaluated on RF and Option C.

audit_results.name: Runtime Latency & Scope
audit_results.code_evidence: N=1024 -> 16,504.7 samples/s (0.0606 ms/sample); N=1 -> 69.40 ms. Classifier-only host benchmark.
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper Section V-D reports single-CPU host throughput of 16,505 samples/sec (0.0606 ms/sample) at N=1024.

audit_results.code_evidence: Edge-IIoTset, NF-ToN-IoT-v2, ToN-IoT, CICIoT2023 (7,000 flows each)
audit_results.paper_statement: Paper lists four datasets with 7,000 flows each.

audit_results.paper_statement: Paper cites Opacus PRV accountant, PyTorch, and scikit-learn algorithms.
